Best. Decision. Ever.

Order a mattress online? What? Well once you have had the hard sell car dealer type vultures try to confuse you at the brick & mortar stores, you will try anything. I researched through several websites (highly recommend Sleepopolis.com) and I decided on the Wink Bed. Because my husband is a big guy, I was concerned about it supporting him while not being miserably firm for me. The Wink folks were so nice and explained they could make a bed a little stronger and supportive for just this type of thing. Knowing we would not have to do anything but be there for delivery (and pick up if it didn't work out), and that we had 101 nights to decide, we ordered a king Wink bed 2 months ago. At first it was like, "Whoa! This seems a little firm." But we took Sleepopolis' advice and Wink's direction to give it time. We were replacing a 15-year-old mattress which was probably too soft when we bought it. Slowly over the weeks it felt more and more right. Now we love it. The way I know? We wake up ready to go in the morning after a good night's sleep. We totally recommend the Wink bed. The people are great and friendly and really, really get excited about making a bed just for you!

Winkbed - The Best bed we have ever owned regardless of price

To begin with, no bed is perfect. There is no One Size Fits all. If you are looking for a well built, solid, spring mattress the Winkbed should be at the top of your list. For some background, before trying the Winkbed to replace a 7 year old Beautyrest, we tried a Sterns and Foster, Sealy, and Saatva. The Sterns and Foster was comfortable but the foam layers started breaking down quickly to the point where it had craters. The Sealy can only be described as dead feeling. After the initial memory foam layers the springs had no give or contour. It almost felt like a futon. Even a family friend slept on it and complained how dead it felt. Then we tried the Saatva. It was well constructed and comfortable. A very nice bed with one exception; it would transfer motion from the other person moving or just shaking their foot. We tried it for over a month and the motion transfer was the worst we had ever experienced in a individual coil bed. We were about to give up and go with a Memory Foam bed but we decided to try Winkbeds. SO GLAD we did. Very slight motion transfer. No smell. Very well made bed. The best part was the actual sleep experience. Both my wife and I sleep very well. In fact we sleep so deeply we are actually sleeping less hours per night than we ever have but wake up with no body aches or pains and very rested. Being 50 years old my wife and I have had many different beds and this is the first bed we both love without exception. I have nothing negative to say at all...it is that nice of a bed. We have had our for 5 months now. We travel fairly extensively to very nice hotels that like to brag about their beds but we can't wait to get back home to the Winkbed. I have read some reviews that say the bed is too firm. Understand this is a coil mattress and it will soften in the first 30-45 days. It starts out at about a 7 out of 10 but after about 30 days will be about 6 out of 10. I know this is going to sound like a commercial, but honestly what do you have to lose by giving it a try? I know there are many "Bed in a Box" companies right now that are all the rage but the Winkbed is a real bed constructed with quality and integrity. I tend to sleep towards the edge of the bed and with our last bed (memory foam) I found myself very sloped towards the floor when I would wake up in the morning not to mention my back hurting terribly. I've had back surgery so I've tried many different beds. So far this is the best one I've come across. We had our other very expensive (30%0+) memory foam bed for maybe a year and I woke up (if I even made it through the night) in terrible pain or stiffness. I did a tremendous amount of research (thanks tuck.com as well as some others). I needed to convince my wife that if we were dumping a barely year old bed that cost that much it had to be for the best bed for us. I've had almost no back pain since this bed arrived. I still have some stiffness from time to time, but that is mostly caused from the activity I was doing that day (mostly lifting something I shouldn't have). I can honestly say I'd buy this bed again and I recommend it to those who have back pain. The other reason I wanted this was for it cooling aspects, as I sleep very hot. I haven't really noticed this feature all that much. I didn't buy the support that does actual cooling, but I may in the near future. I do use very high end sheets (B&B) on this bed and they also add to the experience. This was my first bed in a box purchase and I can say the delivery went well. The bed actually came 12 days earlier than anticipated. One last note is that although the plus bed is for heavier people (300+) my wife and I are not heavy, actually pretty average. I just wanted the firmer bed for my back and it definitely does the job. I can feel the lumbar support when lying flat on my back. The one thing I don't recommend is if you are a stomach sleeper this bed may be too hard. I'm a combination sleeper and only one night so far have i woke up on my stomach and it was a bit uncomfortable. As a point of reference we've had the bed for just over 30 days now. My wife has no complaints but she can also sleep on the floor and be fine. I anticipate the bed breaking in a bit more and us keeping it for a long time, if not forever given the lifetime warranty.

Winkbed - The Best bed we have ever owned regardless of price

To begin with, no bed is perfect. There is no One Size Fits all. If you are looking for a well built, solid, spring mattress the Winkbed should be at the top of your list. For some background, before trying the Winkbed to replace a 7 year old Beautyrest, we tried a Sterns and Foster, Sealy, and Saatva. The Sterns and Foster was comfortable but the foam layers started breaking down quickly to the point where it had craters. The Sealy can only be described as dead feeling. After the initial memory foam layers the springs had no give or contour. It almost felt like a futon. Even a family friend slept on it and complained how dead it felt. Then we tried the Saatva. It was well constructed and comfortable. A very nice bed with one exception; it would transfer motion from the other person moving or just shaking their foot. We tried it for over a month and the motion transfer was the worst we had ever experienced in a individual coil bed. We were about to give up and go with a Memory Foam bed but we decided to try Winkbeds. SO GLAD we did. Very slight motion transfer. No smell. Very well made bed. The best part was the actual sleep experience. Both my wife and I sleep very well. In fact we sleep so deeply we are actually sleeping less hours per night than we ever have but wake up with no body aches or pains and very rested. Being 50 years old my wife and I have had many different beds and this is the first bed we both love without exception. I have nothing negative to say at all...it is that nice of a bed. We have had our for 5 months now. We travel fairly extensively to very nice hotels that like to brag about their beds but we can't wait to get back home to the Winkbed. I have read some reviews that say the bed is too firm. Understand this is a coil mattress and it will soften in the first 30-45 days. It starts out at about a 7 out of 10 but after about 30 days will be about 6 out of 10. I know this is going to sound like a commercial, but honestly what do you have to lose by giving it a try? You have 101 days to try it risk free and if you go to the Winkbeds web page you can even finance the bed. I know there are many "Bed in a Box" companies right now that are all the rage but the Winkbed is a real bed constructed with quality and integrity. It's worth the price and if it was twice as much we would still buy another. We love are Winkbed.

Best one I've Ever Had for Lower Back Pain

For me it comes down to two things, edge support and lower back support. This bed has both. Other than a fairly old solid latex bed (I've never been able to find one like it since) this bed has tremendous edge support. I tend to sleep towards the edge of the bed and with our last bed (memory foam) I found myself very sloped towards the floor when I would wake up in the morning not to mention my back hurting terribly. I've had back surgery so I've tried many different beds. So far this is the best one I've come across. We had our other very expensive (30%0+) memory foam bed for maybe a year and I woke up (if I even made it through the night) in terrible pain or stiffness. I did a tremendous amount of research (thanks tuck.com as well as some others). I needed to convince my wife that if we were dumping a barely year old bed that cost that much it had to be for the best bed for us. I've had almost no back pain since this bed arrived. I still have some stiffness from time to time, but that is mostly caused from the activity I was doing that day (mostly lifting something I shouldn't have). I can honestly say I'd buy this bed again and I recommend it to those who have back pain. The other reason I wanted this was for it cooling aspects, as I sleep very hot. I haven't really noticed this feature all that much. I didn't buy the support that does actual cooling, but I may in the near future. I do use very high end sheets (B&B) on this bed and they also add to the experience. This was my first bed in a box purchase and I can say the delivery went well. The bed actually came 12 days earlier than anticipated. One last note is that although the plus bed is for heavier people (300+) my wife and I are not heavy, actually pretty average. I just wanted the firmer bed for my back and it definitely does the job. I can feel the lumbar support when lying flat on my back. The one thing I don't recommend is if you are a stomach sleeper this bed may be too hard. I'm a combination sleeper and only one night so far have i woke up on my stomach and it was a bit uncomfortable. As a point of reference we've had the bed for just over 30 days now. My wife has no complaints but she can also sleep on the floor and be fine. I anticipate the bed breaking in a bit more and us keeping it for a long time, if not forever given the lifetime warranty.

Before your WinkBed arrives at your home,

Read the WinkBeds story
Watch the WinkBed being handmade in the U.S.A.
SEE THE MATTRESS

Proud, American-Made Quality & Innovation

WinkBeds is a luxury mattress manufacturer founded in 2014.

We believe in supporting workers here at home, so every mattress we make is exclusively produced in either our original Watertown, Wisconsin factory (about 50 miles outside of Milwaukee) or brand new Texas, Connecticut, Florida, & Arizona factories using an innovative hybrid design with high-quality, American-sourced, eco-friendly materials and CertiPur US-Certified foams.

We believe quality comes from true craftsmanship, not mass production.

While most mainstream mattress brands outsource manufacturing and then warehouse their mattresses until they're sold, we build every one of our mattresses by-hand, fresh-to-order. By using exclusively U.S. facilities for manufacturing, we're able to keep a close eye on the production process and quality of our mattresses. Many of the people working at our facilities are skilled craftsmen who have been making mattresses, one at a time, by hand, for decades.

We believe we're in the wellness industry, not the mattress industry.

The one-third of your life spent asleep makes or breaks the two-thirds spent awake. We truly believe WinkBeds provide a better night’s sleep, which can lead to better health and quality of life, because we design our mattresses with that goal in mind. And we back it up with one of the strongest guarantees in the industry.

Our innovation never sleeps, so you always can.

With our lifetime-durable hybrid design, 3-step back-relief system™, Triple-Layer HeatDisperse™ material and patented coolControl™ base, we put our obsessive commitment to comfort on proud display every night.

So rest easy knowing we'll always have your back. In more ways than one :)

Soft Features
Soft Features

Designed specifically for side sleepers and people looking for that "sleeping on a cloud" feeling. This comfort level features a plush Euro-pillow top, an extra layer of pressure relieving hypersoft foam, and a responsive zoned coil system that gently contours to your body’s unique shape.

  1. Extra plush Euro-pillow top

    A three layered Euro-pillow top relieves pressure from the hips and shoulders, gently contouring to your body as if you were sleeping on a cloud. 

  2. Multi-layered comfort construction

    Gently supports and contours while enabling consistent airflow through the mattress for a cool sleep temperature all night long.

  3. Enhanced with more pressure relieving foam

    2” layer of temperature neutral and self adjusting speciality foam maximizes pressure relief even while lying on our side, and provides precise body contour.

  4. Responsive zoned individually wrapped coil system

    Provides targeted support while remaining flexible enough to push back in areas with greater pressure while plying in areas with lighter pressure.

And of course, every WinkBed comes with these unique innovations that help you fall asleep fast, stay asleep longer, and ease back and joint pain. 

  • 3-step Back Relief System to eliminate muscle tension and align the spine and joints.
  • LumbarLayer for extra support in the middle "lumbar region" of your body.
  • Triple Layer Heat-Disperse Material that maximizes a cooler sleep.
  • extraEDGE support system provides more sleepable area through enhanced edge support.
  • SleepCalm Motion Isolation technology.
  • DuraTech Lifetime durability and replacement guarantee.

Luxury Firm Features

Firm Features
Firm Features

Designed for sleepers who want to sleep “on top of the bed” rather than “in the bed,” the Firm features our most supportive Euro-pillow top along with our multi-zone support coil system making this an ideal choice for people who want a firm but not hard mattress.

    A two layered Euro-pillow top ensures your back, hips and shoulders get supportive cushioning that keeps you on top of the mattress.

Plus Features
Plus Features

The WinkBed PLUS is the ultimate mattress designed for people in heavier weight ranges (250 lbs+). It's the most durable mattress on the market. Specifically designed for both luxury comfort and long term support, it's been rated and reviewed by countless mattress experts as a top choice for people in heavier weight ranges. 

---

Note: Individuals 300 lbs and up will experience this mattress as a 6.5/10 while individuals 200 lbs and under will experience this mattress as an 8/10, 10 being the firmest. 

  1. High Density "anti-sag" Foam

    Constructed with high-density foam cushioning, with a minimum density of 1.8 pcf (pounds per cubic foot). That's over 50% denser than the foam in a standard innerspring mattress and is essentially sag-proof.

  2. Lumbar Relief EnduraMax™ Support Foam

    High-density EnduraMax™ foam is engineered to stay firm, supportive, and resilient under higher body weights. No sagging, no premature breakdown. It delivers deep, consistent support night after night, so heavier sleepers get durability and spinal alignment that actually lasts.

  3. Third Party Tested For Durability

    In a simulation of 20 years of bed use by a 350 lb sleeper, the Plus by WinkBeds retained both its loft and and firmness over the simulated time frame. We repeat this test periodically to ensure long term consistency and reliability. 

  4. Patented 5-Zone EliteEdge individually wrapped support coil

    Features a patented individually wrapped coil design that is specifically built to support heavier weights. Coils are banded together and reinforced to ensure a supremely supportive and durable feel.

And of course, every WinkBed comes with these unique innovations that helps you fall asleep fast, stay asleep longer, and ease back and joint pain.

  • 3-Step Back Relief System to eliminate muscle tension and align the spine and joints.

  • Triple Layer Heat-Disperse Material that maximizes a cooler sleep.
  • extraEDGE Support System provides more sleepable area through enhanced edge support.
  • SleepCalm Motion Isolation technology for a less disturbed sleep with partners.
  • DuraTech Lifetime Durability and replacement guarantee.

Most Common FAQs

What makes WinkBeds different from other mattresses?

WinkBeds combines luxury craftsmanship, advanced support, and real value in a way most other mattresses don’t. Each mattress is handcrafted in the USA, using premium materials like our moisture-wicking Tencel® cover, gel-infused foams for temperature regulation, and a proprietary zoned coil system that delivers targeted support and durability.

Unlike many brands that use all-foam designs, WinkBeds are hybrid mattresses—blending responsive foam and individually wrapped coils for better spinal alignment, breathability, and motion isolation. We also offer four firmness options to suit every sleeper, plus a 365-night risk-free trial with easy exchanges if you need a different feel.

From design to delivery, everything we do is focused on giving you long-lasting comfort—without the luxury markup.

How firm is the WinkBed, and which firmness level is right for me?

The WinkBed is available in four firmness options—Softer, Luxury Firm, Firmer, and Plus (for heavier individuals)—so you can choose the feel that best matches your sleep style and body type.

Most sleepers prefer our Luxury Firm, which offers the perfect balance of comfort and support. Side sleepers or those who like a plush feel often love the Softer, while back and stomach sleepers may prefer the extra support of the Firmer. Our Plus model is specially designed for individuals over 250 lbs, with extra-durable foams and a reinforced coil system.

Not sure which to choose? Don’t worry—you’re covered by our risk-free 365-night trial. And if the firmness you select isn’t quite right, we offer easy exchanges with a brand-new mattress for just $49.

Does the WinkBed sleep cool? What materials help with temperature regulation?

Yes, the WinkBed is specifically designed to help you sleep cool and comfortably throughout the night. Each mattress features a breathable, moisture-wicking Tencel® cover derived from eucalyptus, which is softer and cooler than cotton. Beneath the cover, our proprietary gel-infused foam helps dissipate heat, while the individually wrapped coil system promotes steady airflow and prevents heat buildup. The result is a mattress that actively regulates temperature—keeping you cool, dry, and well-supported no matter the season.

Why is it more affordable than other luxury mattresses?

WinkBeds is able to offer premium, American-made mattresses at a lower price by cutting out the middlemen, eliminating retail overhead, and selling online.

We manufacture our mattresses in the USA, which helps avoid import fees and supplier markups. Instead of spending heavily on advertising or celebrity endorsements, we rely on satisfied customers to spread the word. And because our mattresses are built to last, we reduce returns and warranty claims—further keeping costs down.

The result is 5-star comfort without the traditional luxury markup.

Can I use my existing bed frame or platform?

We highly recommend that you match the quality of your new mattress with our Platform Frame.

Old boxsprings or foundations tend to become misshaped and may not provide sufficient support. It may appear that your new mattress is “sagging” when the problem may be due to an inadequate or non-supportive foundation. While the purchase of a foundation or platform is not required, it ensures the mattress remains in good condition and that it feels the way it is supposed to feel.

For the perfect compliment to a WinkBed, we sell an accompanying platform frame. The platform frame is 13″ in height when used with the included legs, or 7.5" in height when used without the legs, and can be used with or without an existing bed frame.

The platform frame ships via FedEx and is easily assembled with no tools required.

Can I use mattresses from WinkBeds on a platform bed or a bed with slats?

Yes, our mattresses will work just fine on a platform or slatted bed frame. We strongly recommend that you double check to make sure your bed frame has a rigid center support. If you are unsure about the level of support your bed frame provides, we strongly recommend that you purchase a platform foundation to ensure adequate support.

Can I try your mattresses in any physical location?

Yes! Our mattress is now available to try in over one hundred showrooms across the country. Find the showroom nearest you using our Store Locator.

How are the mattresses shipped?

Our mattresses are compressed, rolled and shipped straight to your door in a 20" x 20" x 44" box that’s easy to maneuver into your house or apartment. Mattresses are shipped via FedEx Ground with free delivery.

How long will it take to get my mattress?

We offer free ground shipping within the contiguous United States. Depending on where you’re located, and because each of our beds are built-to-order, it will take about one week for you to receive your mattress after placing an order.

Can you remove my old mattress, too?

Yes! Just add the Mattress Removal or Mattress Setup & Removal item to your order when checking out.

What is the Frost™ Cooling Cover?

Our Frost™ Cooling Cover is an upgraded version of our already-cool traditional Tencel cover. It features Advanced Ultra-High Molecular Weight Polyethylene cooling fibers sewn into the fabric to actively draw excess heat away from your body. It delivers an instantly cool-to-the-touch surface to maintain an ideal sleeping temperature for your WinkBed for years to come. Unlike temporary cooling finishes that fade over time, UHMWPE is woven directly into the fabric and is designed to last the life of the fabric.

Does the WinkBed need setup, or can I use it right away?

No need to wait! Your WinkBed is ready to use right out of the box.

What’s included in the 365-night risk-free trial?

Sleep on our mattress for 365 nights. If you don’t love it, we’ll give you a full refund and arrange to pick it up, at your convenience, for free. Since this is the most generous free trial period in the industry, and we have to set a limit somewhere, we just ask that you sleep on the mattress for at least 30 nights before you make a decision. Sound fair?

Please note the 365-night trial applies to orders placed after July 25, 2018. The Platform Frame, The WinkBase, Heavy Duty Bed Frame, 100% Tencel Sheet Set, and Ice Mattress Protector are not covered by the 365-night trial.

If a WinkBed is returned or exchanged, the customer and shipping address will unfortunately not be eligible for additional 365-night trials. The trial is limited to one mattress per customer and household shipping address.

If you exchange one mattress for another, you'll receive a 60 night trial on the second mattress you try.

Can I return or exchange my mattress?

Yes. Every WinkBed comes with a risk-free 365-night sleep trial, so you can try it in your own home. If you don’t love it, we’ll give you a full refund and arrange to pick it up for free—no restocking fees, no return shipping charges. All we ask is that you try the mattress for at least 30 nights before making a decision.

Prefer to try a different firmness? We also offer easy exchanges. Your replacement mattress is free, and there’s just a $49 fee to cover delivery of the new mattress, removal of the original one, and any applicable recycling costs. When you exchange, you’ll receive a new 60-night trial starting the day your second mattress arrives.

Please note: The 365-night trial is limited to one mattress per customer and shipping address. If a mattress is returned or exchanged, future orders will not qualify for additional trial periods.

What financing options are available?

We offer easy and flexible financing through our partners, Bread Pay and Katapult. At checkout, you can choose to pay for your WinkBed over time with monthly payments—often with 0% APR for qualified customers. The application is quick, doesn’t affect your credit score, and you’ll see your terms before you commit. Just select either option at checkout to get started.

How does the lifetime warranty work?

Every WinkBed mattress is backed by a Lifetime Limited Warranty, valid for as long as you own and use the mattress. If your mattress ever develops a covered defect—like a sag deeper than 1.5" (not caused by an improper base) or a manufacturing flaw in the materials—we’ll replace it with a brand new mattress of the same model and size, completely free of charge.

Note: This warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, comfort preference changes, or damage due to misuse, spills, or improper support.

Where can I read the full warranty text?

Your new WinkBeds mattress is covered by a Lifetime Limited Warranty (the “Warranty”) for the full period of the original owner’s (“you”) ownership and use.

WHO IS COVERED

This warranty is valid only for the original purchaser from the original purchase date of the Mattress and is non-transferable. The “original purchaser,” for the purposes of this Warranty, is the first purchaser of the Mattress from Wink Beds LLC (“WinkBeds”) or a WinkBeds authorized retailer. Please retain a copy of your receipt as proof of purchase and owner.

If the original purchaser sells or otherwise relinquishes ownership of the mattress to another, this Warranty terminates and the subsequent owner accepts the product “as is” and “with all faults.”

WHAT IS WARRANTED

This Warranty extends to mattresses manufactured by WinkBeds and purchased directly from WinkBeds or WinkBeds’ authorized retailers (the “Mattresses”).

WinkBeds warrants the Mattress in its original packaging sold to you against the defects in material and workmanship set forth below (“Defects”) for the full period of ownership by you and use by you commencing from the time your Mattress is purchased by you. This warranty is limited to one replacement per mattress purchased. This warranty does not extend to mattresses purchased under the “Any Reason” replacement guaranty.

THE FOLLOWING DEFECTS ARE COVERED:

Deterioration causing the Mattress to have a visible indentation greater than one (1.5”) one and one half inches that is not associated with an indentation or sag which results from use of an improper or unsupportive foundation or bed base. Normal wear requires that a Mattress be continuously supported by a matching foundation or adjustable bed base with a proper bed frame sufficient to support the collective weight of the Mattress and user(s).

Any physical flaw in the Mattress due to a manufacturing defect that causes the foam or spring material to evidence degradation, split or crack, despite normal usage and proper handling.

THIS MATTRESS WARRANTY DOES NOT COVER

Any product which has been subject to misuse, neglect, accident or used in violation of instructions, including instructions to place mattress on proper bed frame. A normal increase in softness of the foam pressurerelieving material which does not affect the pressurerelieving qualities of the Mattress. Comfort preference. Defects caused by physical abuse or damage to the structure and/or cover material, including but not limited to, burns, cuts, tears, liquid damage, or stains. Mattresses sold “as-is”, “preconditioned”, “reconditioned”, “used”, “returned”, “previously owned”, or any other similar wording indicating that the Mattress is not “new” or of “first quality”, or has previously been purchased or used by another consumer.

WARRANTY REMEDY

In the event of a Defect (as defined above), WinkBeds’ sole liability and your sole remedies under this Warranty will be:

A replacement of your defective mattress with a brand new WinkBeds mattress in the same model and size at absolutely no charge to you.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

In order for this Warranty to apply, the Mattresses must be used on a firm, rigid, non-flexible surface with an ample center support leg(s), such as a bed base that is structurally capable of supporting the weight of the Mattress and user(s) for the entirety of its use. Purchaser must prove that matching foundation or adjustable bed base with a proper bed frame sufficient to support the collective weight of the Mattress and user(s) was used.

You must return your Mattress and show proof of original purchase. At WinkBeds’ option, WinkBeds may authorize you to provide photo evidence of defect in lieu of returning the Mattress. You are responsible for the shipping costs associated with returning your mattress. However, if WinkBeds determines that a Defect exists, WinkBeds will assume all transportation costs associated with returning and replacing your mattress.

Do you have any statistics about the durability of the foam you use?

Yes. An independent organization called the the Carpenter Technical Center performed a study on the durability of the foams we use in our mattress. The test, named the constant force fatigue test, simulates 10 years of bed usage by dropping a 168-lb weight on a block of foam 80,000 times. That is far more abuse than a mattress will ever see in a person’s home, even over an extended period of years.

Do you make custom-sized mattresses?

No, we do not make custom sized mattresses.

What type of fire barrier is in the WinkBed?

All mattresses that are sold in the US are required to have a fire barrier. The WinkBed and GravityLux use an all natural fire barrier that is made from a blend of cotton and rayon. The EcoCloud Hybrid uses a natural wool fire barrier.

Do your mattresses have environmental certifications?

Yes, all of the foam in our beds are CertiPUR-US certified, which means the foam in our beds is made without ozone-depleters, PBDE flame retardants, mercury, lead and heavy metals, formaldehyde, prohibited phthalates regulated by the Consumer Product Safety Commission. It’s also low in volatile organic compound emissions, at less than 0.5 parts per million.

Frames, Boxsprings, and Adjustable Bases

Do your mattresses work on an adjustable frame?

Yes, our mattresses are all compatible with adjustable bed frames.

Will my mattress work on my existing boxspring or foundation?

We generally recommend purchasing both the mattress and platform. However, if your box spring/foundation is in very good condition, meaning it’s sturdy, has no sagging, and remains a rigid and even surface, it should work fine.

Reviews

Where can I read reviews of the WinkBed Mattress?

You can read reviews of our beds on any of the following websites: Sleepopolis.com, Sleepadvisor.com, Tuck.com, MattressClarity.com, SleepSherpa.com, GirlOnTheMattress.com, Mattress-guides.net, and of course, on our website!

Shipping and Delivery

What is included with free delivery?

We are pleased to be able to offer free delivery service to our customers. When you select free delivery, our dedicated shipping partners will deliver your mattress and/or accessories right to the ground level door of your house or apartment building. Installation of the mattress is not included. The free delivery does not include installation of the mattress or carrying the mattress up any stairs. Free delivery is available within the contiguous United States.

Do you ship internationally?

No, we ship within the USA only.

Mattress Care

Do I need a mattress protector?

While certainly not required, a protective pad can help keep your mattress clean and stain-free.

Should I flip or rotate my mattress?

Most mattresses go through a break-in period where the foams begin to soften up with normal use. To elongate the life of your mattress and make sure the foams break in evenly, we recommend rotating your mattress every two weeks for the first three months, then every 2 months thereafter.

Can I Try the Winkbed in Stores?

Can I try your mattresses in any physical location?

Yes! Our mattress is now available to try in over 150 showrooms across the country. Find the showroom nearest you using our Store Locator.

Made with American-sourced, eco-friendly materials

Sustainably manufactured

Our Tencel mattress cover is derived from Eucalyptus trees. The raw materials are harvested from a Forest Stewardship Council-certified forest, guaranteeing plant production comes from only responsibly managed forests.

We use 10-20x less water required to make the fabric, so the production has a much lower carbon footprint.

Our coils are made from recycled steel and impurity-free iron, then triple tempered.

Safe for us and our planet

WinkBeds foams are CertiPure certified, made without any ozone depleters, PBDE flame retardants, mercury, lead, formaldehyde, prohibited phthalates, and is low in volatile organic compound emissions.

US Law requires every mattress use a Fire barrier. So while many mainstream brands use toxic chemical and adhesive barriers, WinkBeds barriers are made with absolutely NO chemicals or additives included.
